name: corals
description: Coral bleaching is one of the most visible consequences of ocean warming — but the data behind it is rarely accessible to non-scientists. This project turns 40 years of global observations into an interactive web app where anyone can explore how rising temperatures affect coral reefs around the world.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client -c cyan,magenta ".venv/bin/python api/app.py" "npm start --prefix client"
